thread:
nina (People Ops): quick post-all-hands follow-up on headcount + the hub/pod questions. dropping the concise Q&A and links.
omar (Eng): thanks. short Q  
 are hubs a new org change or just a clarity map?
sylvie (Recruiter): heard in live chat people were worried about freezes. is hiring paused?
mel (Finance): no freeze. tighter prioritization. we have a Q-level cap and org envelopes. hubs are an ownership map, not a reorg  
 they show hub leads and pod owners so handoffs are clearer.
nina (People Ops): priority buckets we mentioned: (A) revenue-facing product teams (B) infra/runtime focused on cost & p95 (C) platform for Dedicated/Private launches (D) security/compliance.
omar (Eng): if i move an IC into another pod, does that free a slot for me to hire?
nina (People Ops): internal moves prioritized. backfills evaluated within the originating org's envelope first. transfers that preserve capacity often don't consume net new slots.
sylvie (Recruiter): process reminder: managers file the short hire form (link in the deck). hiring committee (People Ops + Eng + Finance) scores requests. large >2 FTE asks need exec OK.
omar (Eng): what about offers already verbalized? we can't lose candidates waiting on slots.
ops-bot: [automated] flag: mark form "urgent-offer" to trigger fast-track.
mel (Finance): for urgent offers contact me and nina  
 we'll aim to decide within 48 hours.
nina (People Ops): small change to scorecards: please add one-line "3mo expected impact" to help compare requests.
sylvie (Recruiter): relocation & sign-on still on case-by-case. committee may cap standard relocations; exceptions for senior/critical roles.
omar (Eng): on-call/SRE hiring  
 where do they land?
nina (People Ops): on-call and SRE roles where primary charter is production reliability are in infra/runtime bucket. call that out in the justification.
mel (Finance): sales-triggered Dedicated bookings will auto-unlock hiring credits for Platform. tracker will show unlocked credits.
noah (CEO): context: this is about focus and being intentional with spend, not cutting teams. managers  
 quantify expected outcomes (metrics) in the form.
sylvie (Recruiter): hiring-tracker link and form will be posted to #all-hands in 30m. keep candidate stages up to date so we can move quickly.
nina (People Ops): i'll pin the tracker + a short FAQ. DM for urgent approvals. thanks all  
 :white_check_mark:
